name: Rakuten Group, Inc.
summary: Rakuten Group, Inc. provides various services in e-commerce, fintech, digital content, and communications to various users in Japan, the Americas, Europe, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Internet Services, FinTech, and Mobile. The company operates a range of e-commerce sites comprising Rakuten Ichiba, an Internet shopping mall; online cash-back sites; travel booking sites; portal sites; and digital content sites, as well as provides messaging services. It also offers credit card, banking, and securities services through the Internet; crypto asset/virtual currency spot transactions; life and general insurance services; and payment services.
